title: The Due cell shows the earliest candidate and its trigger
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. A service watching several triggers, and a service whose meter has no usable readings. Seed a service with a calendar + mileage + hours trigger, and a meter-watching service with no readings.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Due cell of a multi-trigger service and look for other candidate dates.
  2. Open the row menu and find the other candidates / Other triggers.
  3. Read the Due cell of a service whose meter has no readings.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Due cell shows one line: the earliest candidate and the trigger that produced it; every other candidate is reachable from the row menu rather than stacked in the cell.
  • A service whose meter has no usable readings shows the calendar date and reads "Calendar - needs mileage reading" (or engine hours) - the ordinary case, not a warning.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S9 (confidence display copied from S11); read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R12: “The Due cell shows one line: the earliest candidate and the trigger that produced it. Every other candidate is reachable from the row menu rather than stacked in the cell, because a service resets on the first trigger and the later candidates are then recomputed”
  • S9-N3: “A service whose meter has no usable readings shows the calendar date and reads Calendar · needs mileage reading, or engine hours. This is the ordinary case, not a warning”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
